answer: Each agent posts a stake before acting and lights a unique lantern: a signed commitment bound to one hardware fingerprint. When a gale of fake identities hits, any duplicate lantern exposed by cross-checks burns its full bond, so flooding the network costs attackers real capital. Honest agents then tend the shared garden by auditing neighbors, and every proven sybil's forfeited stake funds a bounty for the auditor, making attack cost exceed any gain.
